item.description:
Backup errors now identify the mismatching category, such as access rules, extended attributes, creation date, or file contents.

No signature contents, attribute values, or account identifiers are included in these diagnostics. Backup verification remains mandatory; failed verification stops before changing the signature.

This diagnostic release retains the inherited-permissions fix from 0.1.2. It does not claim to resolve every backup mismatch.

Fixes a backup verification failure when applying HTML signatures with inherited file permissions.

  • Preserves original access rules in backups and installed signatures.
  • Keeps verification, file locking, and rollback protections intact.

This remains a preview release.

EasySign 0.1.1 adds a simple first-run setup.

  • Choose your signatures folder, with permission help and Retry.
  • Optionally connect Mail for sender profiles.
  • Skip setup and reopen it from Help → Set Up EasySign.

This remains a preview release. Sender-name delivery, iCloud synchronization, and older macOS compatibility have known limitations. See the user guide before relying on profiles.
